t: You're on St John's Wood Road, a street in the City of Westminster. This is where the novelist and critic Samuel Butler died. He's best known for the satirical utopian novel Erewhon, published in 1872, and for The Way of All Flesh, a semi-autobiographical work. Both have stayed in print ever since. He also wrote about Christian orthodoxy, evolutionary thought and Italian art, and his prose translations of the Iliad and Odyssey are still consulted today.
